notes:
REF-BM-04: Bookmark title, description, tags, and note can be edited, but editing URL is not supported in the UI or PATCH API.
REF-BM-14: No `#tag` search syntax is implemented; search performs only substring matching.
REF-BM-15: Search does not support boolean AND/OR/NOT operators or parenthesised groups.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not handled as exact match queries.
REF-BM-20: Multi-item selection and bulk actions are not implemented.
REF-BM-21: Applying bulk actions across filtered collections is not implemented.
REF-BM-22: No sorting controls or sort-by-key options are implemented.
REF-BM-23: Rich-text note authoring and rendering exists via sanitized HTML rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML and PDF page snapshot preservation is not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved bundles of search terms and tag filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML bookmark import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML bookmark export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: User display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) are not implemented.
